incidents.summary: Diageo agreed to pay a $5 million civil fine to settle SEC charges that it pressured distributors to buy excess inventory to boost its results.

sources.title: Diageo to pay £3.84 million to settle SEC charges it concealed liquor overshipments
sources.quote: (Reuters) - Diageo Plc agreed to pay a $5 million(£3.84 million) civil fine to settle U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission charges that the global liquor company quietly pressured distributors to buy excess inventory to boost its results in a flagging market.

sources.title: Diageo to pay £3.84 million to settle SEC charges it concealed liquor overshipments
sources.quote: The London-based company - whose brands include Johnnie Walker Scotch whisky, Smirnoff vodka, Tanqueray gin and Guinness beer - did not admit or deny wrongdoing, but agreed to cease and desist from further violations, the SEC said on Wednesday.

incidents.summary: Diageo was fined £537,500 after pleading guilty to safety failures following a distillery incident that left an employee with burns to 30% of his body.

sources.title: Diageo fined £537k after worker suffered burns at distillery
sources.quote: The former employee, Michael Thomson, sustained burns to 30% of his body following an incident where a faulty valve caused 10,000 litres of 104 centigrade liquid to engulf him.

sources.title: Diageo fined £537k after worker suffered burns at distillery
sources.quote: During a hearing at Inverness Sheriff Court, Diageo pleaded guilty to failing to take the necessary steps to ensure that work equipment was safely built and adapted, along with other failures.

sources.title: Diageo fined £537k after worker suffered burns at distillery
sources.quote: The manufacturer, which owns brands such as Guinness and Johnnie Walker, was fined £537,500.

incidents.summary: A proposed US class action alleged that Diageo falsely labeled Casamigos and Don Julio tequilas as entirely agave-derived despite containing other alcohols.

sources.title: Federal Lawsuit Accuses Diageo of Adulterating Its Tequilas
sources.quote: A class action lawsuit filed in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York accuses Diageo of falsely labeling Casamigos and Don Julio tequilas as “100% agave,” alleging the presence of non-agave alcohols like cane spirits.

sources.title: Federal Lawsuit Accuses Diageo of Adulterating Its Tequilas
sources.quote: Diageo strongly denies the allegations, asserting its tequilas meet all regulatory standards and are certified by the CRT and U.S. authorities.

incidents.summary: Indian authorities seized thousands of Diageo whisky and vodka bottles in a food safety crackdown and inspected a factory of its subsidiary in Bengaluru.

sources.title: EXCLUSIVE: India seizes thousands of Diageo whisky, vodka bottles in food safety crackdown | Reuters
sources.quote: India seizes thousands of Diageo whisky, vodka bottles in food safety crackdown

sources.title: EXCLUSIVE: India seizes thousands of Diageo whisky, vodka bottles in food safety crackdown | Reuters
sources.quote: Indian officials inspected a factory of Diageo unit in Bengaluru

incidents.summary: Indian authorities investigated whether Diageo incorrectly classified bulk Scotch imports to obtain lower tariffs under the India-UK trade pact.

sources.quote: The other two people said Diageo is also being investigated for how it classifies some Scotch imports.

sources.title: Exclusive-India probing Pernod, Diageo Scotch imports under India-UK trade pact, sources say By Reuters
sources.quote: Diageo, also in a statement, said it is cooperating with Indian authorities, and has always complied with local laws.

sources.title: Exclusive-India probing Pernod, Diageo Scotch imports under India-UK trade pact, sources say By Reuters

incidents.summary: A toxic spill associated with Diageo's Cardhu distillery killed thousands of fish and other wildlife in Knockando Burn, prompting an apology, updated controls and an ongoing SEPA investigation.

sources.title: Diageo’s Toxic Spill Hits a Pristine River in Scottish Whisky Country
sources.quote: Earlier this year, a toxic chemical spill into a critical spawning tributary killed thousands of fish and other wildlife, blighting fishing in the area for decades.

sources.title: Diageo faces probe over toxic spill in Scotland - Just Drinks
sources.quote: Diageo confirmed to Just Drinks that this incident concerns the Cardhu distillery.

sources.title: Diageo faces probe over toxic spill in Scotland - Just Drinks
sources.quote: They added: “We have updated controls in place, are continuing to fully engage with SEPA as they carry out their investigation and are in discussions on a long-term plan to support regeneration and restoration in the area.”
